programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey and the crew hit the ground running with a late model replacement bed from LMC that’s sure to revive and old Ford farm truck and get it out of the pastures and back on the highway. Then it’s off to show budding Jeep enthusiasts a couple of entry level options they can use when it comes to modifying their vehicle. We get a visit from a couple who learn how to install new seat upholstery. Stacey’s found something cool for all you second generation Camaro owners. And we’re just getting started! So get ready to turn some wrenches on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The GearZ crew and Cornwell Tools team up to help a new shop in Arkansas get some much-needed tools to help them take they’re shop the next level. Then Stacey puts together the final pieces of the Sgt. Rock project by making a trip to France and the beaches of Normandy. Then it’s back to the shop to show you how easy it is to put fuel injection on your muscle car. It’s all here… and only on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Season 10 Starts off with America’s favorite military tribute truck! Sgt. Rock is back and ready for final assembly! Garage Guru, Stacey David, takes us on a tour de force of custom fabrication as he covers all the nuts and bolts of what it’s taken to get Sgt. Rock ready to rumble. Builders of all levels are in for a great show as Stacey tackles one of a kind steering columns, gas pedals and designing a console that not only fits form, but also function. Gauge techs will keep your instrument panels in line. And a quick tip will keep your wires from fraying and your hoses from splitting. All this and more as Sgt. Rock and Season 10 hit the road full throttle.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: A custom build can lose some power if the theme doesn’t stay consistent. Stacey shows how to do that by taking you through the process of how to make door and kick panels that keep the rugged military WWII bomber vibe flowing throughout the interior of Sgt. Rock. After that, its some tips on how to fit a radiator and that all-important cooling fan in a place where space is limited. Finally, the gas tank and battery placement are critical on a custom vehicle and Stacey goes through the steps in doing that as well. If you’ve always wanted to build a custom vehicle, this episode is sure to get your fabrication gearZ turning.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Two things are certain in life: death and taxes. We all know what to do with taxes, but what happens when a loved one passes and leaves behind an unfinished project vehicle? How do you know what’s sitting in your garage? And how can you find out? Stacey tackles these questions and takes you on a thorough inventory of an almost finished restoration that was left to a widow when her husband suddenly died. A new dash going into your vehicle? A gauge tech should keep you from crossing your wires. And we’ve got tips that should help with battery relocation and lining up your vehicle’s body panels.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Gearz On The Road - Basic Tools
programme.desc: The GearZ crew mount up and head out to visit a young gear-head whose love of wrenching started with 4-wheelers and has grown to include 4-wheel drive pick ups. Young Adam has a few surprises in store as Stacey visits him in his Dad’s garage and discusses tools, storage and tearing apart things to see how they work. Then, it’s back in the shop as Stacey takes on the big question every gear-head has: What OTHER tools should I have in my box? A look beyond the typical wrenches, hammers and clamps will show you what you may need and what you may not, depending on your project.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Cheetah Body Work Latches Custom Exhaust
programme.desc: The son of legendary car builder, Bill Thomas, talks shop about wrenching, racing and his father’s Cobra Killer…the Cheetah. Then Stacey heads over to Stainless Works to check out how the Cheetah’s custom side pipes, headers and mufflers came together. A Gauge Tech explains the pros and cons of mechanical vs. electric gauges. After that, a Quick Tip explains the proper way to use some of those mystery tools laying around in your tool box.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Ever wonder why your wife or best buddy won’t step foot in your late model truck? It could be that crusty interior. Tag along as Stacey takes on the sights and smells of an ’83 Chevy in dire need of some attention. From new dash to leather on the bench seat and new carpet in the floor, Stacey shows you what a difference a weekend and some parts from LMC can make. Speaking of trucks, Stacey raises the bar with a bed lifter that will make you the most popular guy in your neighborhood. A new buffer is going to help add some shine to your vehicle and a creeper that’s simply “Magic” is sure to raise an eyebrow or two. Big things are happening in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Through the years, we’ve had some amazing vehicles featured on GearZ—from elite racecars to the insanity of a V-8 barstool. Well, here we go again! Stacey hauls in a Thiokol Imp that needs some…attention. First things first with this crazy snowcatmobile; we’ve got to see if we can make it run. Follow along as Stacey takes you through the ins and outs of getting a neglected vehicle up and running again. For you performance BMW guys, a tuner from Dinan is going add the horses you’ve been looking for. We’ve got sparks flying, fuel splashing and all kinds of garage mayhem this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: In the world of car building there are few things more ominous than missing titles or VIN numbers. But there is one task that stands out, one that brings grown men to tears, one that is usually lurking behind 100 yards of electrical tape…WIRING. Well hold on tight as Stacey dives head first into wiring Sergeant Rock. That’s right; see how painless Stacey can make wiring the big old truck. Follow along as Stacey moves front to back and gets the Rock one step closer to hitting the road!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With summer in full swing, it’s time to cool down that classic truck of yours. That’s right, roll those windows up and feel the cool breeze as Stacey shows just how easy it is to install this complete AC system from LMC Truck. Now that you’re done sweatin’, let’s take a look at headers and intakes and get that motor performing the way it should. And don’t miss out on the ins and outs of turbos and super-chargers…which one fits your needs? All this and plenty of sparks in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey and the GearZ crew heat things up as they head to the Cornwell forges to watch molten steel be expertly transformed into America’s best ratchet. Get ready to see sparks fly. But the trip doesn’t stop there. Tag along as the crew follows what it takes for a ratchet to end up on a Cornwell truck. Back in the garage, Stacey talks maximizing boost and the role of intercoolers when it comes to super-chargers and turbos. The wheels keep turning and the rubber keeps burning, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Cheetah lovers will be excited to see Stacey’s solution to keeping the headers both cool and looking red hot. Want to keep using your stock tank after converting to fuel injection? Get psyched, because Holley has a new fuel pump that’s going to make your life a whole lot easier. Think your car is buttoned up tight? Stacey and some friends from Redline Detection blow smoke at the old soap and water test and show you how to really test for leaks in your vehicle. It’s a world of problems out there, but Stacey’s got you covered in the garage. All this and more, this week, on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: This week Stacey and crew head to Memphis, TN to help out a local BBQ pitmaster who’s deep into a ground up rebuild of a ’72 Nova. The big challenge here?...Can you swap out an automatic transmission with a manual without losing your mind? Well, Stacey is always up for a good challenge and he’ll show you just how simple this swap can be. A new tuner from Super chips will make your Jeep life easier, and replacement dashes for Chevy owners are going to light up their eyes. There’s a lot going on in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Cheap Fuel Injection Snow Cat Bed TN Electric Guitar
programme.desc: We’re winding up the tenth season of GearZ, and what a season it’s been! But we’ve got some business to take care of before we move onto season eleven. First things first…Holley just made an EFI even easier to install on your carbureted vehicle, and Stacey will show you just how on target the Sniper is. The Thiokol Imp gets a suspension upgrade to keep it on track. And there’s a new kind of off-roading that’s sweeping the nation…see what RC4WD has going on. And what season would be complete without guitars? Check out Tennessee Electric Company as Stacey introduces a new guitar-maker whose custom guitars are hotter than the asphalt at the drag strip.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re back and taking it to the streets! Season 11 comes roaring back with a look at Super Lite Cars on the road and the track! Stacey recalls and earlier SLC build and introduces two SLC builders who took a very hands-on approach to putting their cars together. These street/race cars are sure to catch your eye and get your racing blood flowing. If there’s one thing Stacey preaches on every episode, it’s paying attention to the details. His quick tip is no exception, getting rid of those sharp edges and nasty welds to give your project the small details that people will notice. Side mirrors for a muscle car, building a better battery, and keeping your air flowing through carbon fiber vents fill out the parts bin. We’ve got all this and more as Stacey kicks of his 11th season of GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: This is the moment you’ve been waiting for! Master car builder, Stacey David, shows off the truck that’s had the nation talking for ten years! Take a look back at the kid with the dream. Follow the design and fabrication. See what happens when the military tribute vehicle rolls out and conquers the road! This episode is gonna be epic. It’s been a long road, but anything worth doing well is worth the wait. This week, the wait is over. Sergeant Rock Lives!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: On the Road & Unicure Spray Booths
programme.desc: Things are rockin’ and rollin’ in and out of the GearZ garage. Stacey hits the road to find a project build that will get gear heads buzzing. He ends up with an ’81 Camaro and some awesome stories from the seller. If you’re talking project vehicles, you’ve got to talk paint! And Stacey does just that with folks from Unicure, who specialize in paint booths and helping you get set up for that all important paint job. The V-8 Interceptor is back from a trip to Stainless works, where a custom exhaust system was made for the big Boss Nine engine. Things are about to get loud, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: The Return of Heavy Metal & Snowcat
programme.desc: Stacey and the GearZ crew roll in an old favorite: Heavy Metal. The coolest hotrod tow truck is back in the garage and ready for a facelift. Our good friends at the Hot Rod Institute drop by and talk shop with Stacey about his plans for the paint and fab work needed to get this bad boy looking good and back on the road. Fresh from the sandblaster, the snowcat reveals the scars that were under the skin. And with the drive train out, Stacey walks through the importance of replacing gaskets, seals and checking for wear and tear before stuffing that engine, transmission and skid steer rear end back into the cat. There’s a whole lot going on this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Every gear head has a secret: they all want to drive like McQueen in Bullitt, or Vin Diesel in The Fast And The Furious. But when the heat gets turned up, even some really good drivers can’t keep up. That’s when you bring in the Stunt Double! This week Stacey sits down with legendary Hollywood stunt man Ian Quinn to talk crashing cars and keeping actors out of harms way. There’s also a new project in the garage: The Stunt Double, a build inspired by the 80’s tv show The Fall Guy, and sure to get all four wheels off the ground before Stacey’s done with it. Sparks are going to fly and you know we’re gonna have a good time this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Seems like you can’t go more than a block these days without running into someone whose had some work done on their face. Well, here at the GearZ garage, Stacey believes in facelifts too. Just to prove it, he’s taken on a 1981 Camaro and sharpened his scalpel to perform an automotive nose job. Just wait till you see him whack of the old rubber nose and replace it with a 71’ rally sport front end! Now that’s what we call a facelift. Plenty of people said it couldn’t be done, but that’s just the kind of challenge Stacey is up for. Plenty of sparks are gonna fly, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: They say that true change comes from within… Well, this week Stacey turns his attention to the interior of the Stunt Double. The old, crusty junk hits the floor and our Fall Guy inspired build gets a new look: from painting trim and door panels, to a new bench seat. Man o’ man, this truck is starting to look completely different. A shower of sparks lights up the garage as Stacey demonstrates how to make a bracket that mounts our new bench seat to the truck while using the stock seat adjustment. It’s a tour de force of aftermarket parts and salvaging what we’ve got, this week on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: When you’re putting together a project that’s inspired by a high-flying stunt truck, you know you’ve got to add some lift, and our Stunt Double gets the goods this week. The front and rear suspension get treated to a 6” lift to get that rig up in the air. But a good lift won’t do any good if the steering and frame can’t hold up, so Stacey shows you how Offroad Design has fixed some serious issues that many late model four-wheel drives encounter. Bed need to come off your truck, but the carriage bolts are rusted and spinning? Stacey’s got a fix for that too. There’s a lot going on, and we’ve got you covered, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Everyone needs a little boost here and there. For some people, coffee does the trick. But here in the GearZ Garage we take our boost seriously. And we like ours packing 160 HP. Hang on to your seat as Stacey adds a bolt on Supercharger to a Ram 1500 breathes a little excitement into a daily driver. And speaking of things going on in the garage, you’ll definitely want to stick around as Stacey talks shop with the guys at Rebuilding Generations. Learn all about how this mentoring program is teaching the next generation about working on cars and sharing plenty of life lessons. We’ve got a lot going on this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re running full steam ahead as the Stunt Double rolls back into the shop this week! First, Stacey reveals the wheels and tires that are going to accentuate that 6” lift, then He dives headlong into the drivetrain of this beast and comes up with a hot crate engine and a high-performance transmission to get the Stunt Double ready for the road. But that’s not all…. We also take some time out for a visit with the guys from American Powertrain and so much more. Check out the sparks flying in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s business as usual in the garage this week. We’re back at work on the Catalog Camaro and really diggin’ into the front end. You know what they say, “out with the old and in with the new,” and that’s exactly what Stacey’s doing. The old sub frame, drivetrain, and suspension are hitting the garage floor in favor of a much-needed updated suspension system that’ll keep this awesome Camaro hugging the road at high speeds—From the wheels to the sub frame, Stacey’s replacing it all. And he’s not going to break the bank while doing it, either. Follow the GearZ crew as they hit the road and visit Cornwell Tools to see their latest and greatest tool box being manufactured. From powder coat to knuckle bustin’ bolts, we’ve got you covered this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We head out of the garage to visit one of the premiere supercharger manufacturers in the world… ATI Pro Charger. Follow along for the ride as Stacey walks through the entire process of how they have raised the bar on how a supercharger is built and what it does. From bulk metal to dyno runs, we’ve got it covered. Back in the garage, a young Gearhead drops by to learn how to install an air intake and cowl induction hood on his pick-up. After the wrench turning is done, he and Stacey have enough time to hit a few licks on their guitars. From massive horsepower increases with state-of-the-art tools and machinery, to simple intake and hood installs,….. it’s all here, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey is in full hot rod mode as he unveils a wicked LS engine and Tremec 6spd tranny and stuffs it into the Catalog Camaro. If 600hp and a 6spd in a Camaro doesn’t get you going, the update on the Stunt Double will! It’s old school cool as Stacey shows off the stainless light bar, side steps and cutout flairs to give the truck that “Fall Guy” vibe. After that we introduce you to the amazing world of scale R/C that is sure to have you re-thinking what you want for Christmas! Finally we roll in some updates on the Cheetah and the Junkyard Jag too. If you’re a gearhead, you’re gonna find a whole lot to love about this show!......and that’s GEARZ!!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Season 12 opens with bang as Stacey starts the final assembly process on the V8 Interceptor. If you’ve ever wondered how to lay out an aftermarket A/C system, wiring harness, and steering column on your project… and make them all work together, you have to see this show! After that, NHRA legend and Hall-of-Famer, Doug Herbert drops by the GearZ garage to share the shocking story that inspired him to start the B.R.A.K.E.S. driving program. Hold on tight, because this ain't your typical high school driver's Ed. Program! If you want cool tech and awesome stories… you’re gonna find that on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s all about fabrication and thinking outside the box, or to be more specific... outside the bed! Sure, sure, there are plenty of custom pick-up truck beds you can buy but Stacey shows you what is involved in MAKING a custom bed to fit any vehicle, even something as crazy as a Thiokol Imp snowcat! That's right… our little snowcat is back from the sand blaster and ready for a cool bed to match the cab. Stacey goes in-depth about sizing up the project, picking the right parts, and most importantly: how to cut, weld, grind and finish sheet metal to get a bed that will fit your unique vehicle like a glove. So grab a welder… it’s time to make your bed!... only on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey takes a trip to Fort Carson, Colorado to visit the Army auto skills program during their world conference. Not only does Stacey get to meet a General, but he also meets a young Sergeant who is in the middle of a frame-off square body restoration. After a thorough walk around, Stacey decides to get LMC involved in helping out with this build. Parts for the bed of his truck can’t match the gratitude we share for our active military and all those who have served, but it’s a start. And we can’t wait to see the project when it’s finished. And speaking of new beds, with the custom bed on the Snow Cat, it’s time to address the tracks, and Right Track Systems has us covered. That little cat is going to tear it up when all is said and done! It’s going to be a lot of fun, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s all about Cougars! No, not that kind of Cougar... the kind with 4 wheels and a legendary pedigree! After a short history lesson about how these cars came into existence and why they were so cool, Stacey rolls the V8 Interceptor back into the shop and digs into the final assembly of this wild ’67 Mercury Cougar. This week’s episode focuses on planning out your final assembly, and taking care of all the little details, before you put the big things in like engine and transmission. Whether it’s planning out your brake system, battery location, or running fuel lines, Stacey shows how a little extra time in the planning department will make all the difference in your build.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey takes us through the history of the legendary SR-71 Blackbird. If you’re not familiar with this bird, it could fly mach 3.2, cruise at 80,000 feet and kept our country safe through its many reconnaissance missions. Never shot down, and never outrun, it was the hot rod of the sky! Stacey gets to sit down with pilot Lt. Col. Ed Yeilding and talk about his record setting transcontinental flight—Coast to Coast in 67 minutes and 54 seconds! The iconic Blackbird was such an inspiration that you know Stacey had to make a vehicle inspired by and paying tribute to it, so get ready to meet the SR-71 Rapid Tool Express!!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Catalog Camaro Butt Lift and Tummy Tuck
programme.desc: The Catalog Camaro is back in the garage and ready to go under the knife as Stacey shows how to do a butt lift and tummy tuck on a 2nd generation Camaro. What does that mean? Well, last season Stacey performed a nose job on this old ’81 Camaro to show how easy it is to get rid of the 80’s plastic front bumpers and put on the classic early 70’s split-bumper, rally sport front sheetmetal. This week he continues the makeover by losing the plastic rear bumper and wrap-around taillights and grafting in the early 70’s quarter panels, round taillights and chrome bumper. It’s more in depth than the front and definitely requires some skilled metal surgery, but Stacey shows you all the tricks on how to do it properly. So, sit back and enjoy the ride as Stacey details how to measure, cut, and weld your way to a much younger looking Camaro.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in a Big Bad Buick Riviera and shows you what is possible with the right vehicle and some bolt on parts. This 1972 Riviera is a great entry-level project that won’t break the bank, and has the potential to serve some serious humble-pie to any unsuspecting hot shot that may want to mix it up at the stoplight. As it sits, the big 455 under the hood is a force to be reckoned with, but Stacey shows what a weekend in the garage and a top end rebuild can do for a car like this! Get ready to get your hands dirty and bust a few knuckles as Stacey pulls the old heads, intake, cam, and ignition off and replaces them with performance parts from companies like TA Performance, Edelbrock, and MSD. It’s a lesson in Buick and bolt-on horsepower, and you’re only gonna find it on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The GearZ crew hits the road this week and travels to the Charlotte Speed Shop to see how paint prep is going on Stacey’s Cheetah Evolution Car. With the hood and side vents glassed in and smoothed out, the first coat of primer gets sprayed and this awesome cat takes one big step closer to coming home! Stacey also stops by to visit with a fellow boat tail Riviera owner and trade tips on beefing up these classic beauties. It turns out that this guy and Stacey had both been watching this same car when it came up for sale! Come hang out with us as we visit some great folks this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey gets down to business on the Big Bad Buick. With the top end engine rebuilt, the exterior and interior of the car need some serious updating. You don’t have to spend a ton of cash on simple modifications. Stacey shows what’s behind making a good clean line with your bumpers and how a simple front and rear bumper tuck can drastically change the appearance. Replacing the grille and scraping off that old vinyl top are also sure-fire ways to add attitude to this big ol’ boat tail. That old carpet has got to go! Follow along as Stacey shows the ins and outs and some tips and tricks to keep your exterior and interior redo from breaking the bank.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Not everyone out there is wrenching on an a classic. In fact, we get tons of emails from viewers who want to upgrade brand-new vehicles but aren’t sure how to get started. Well, Stacey has the answer—and it comes with a little help from our friend and NASCAR legend Jimmie Johnson and a stunning 2018 Camaro SS. Come hang out in the garage as Stacey walks you through the top seven modifications that you can make to a car that you just drove off the lot! Everything from paint upgrades to wheels, Stacey’s got a list. Let’s get started!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey’s hard at work on a 2018 Camaro SS. This build is super-cool, not only because he’s running down a list of the top seven mods you can make on a brand-new car, but also because seven-time NASCAR champion, Jimmie Johnson is involved with the project. We’ve covered paint mods, body mods, and interior mods. Now it’s time to go under the hood and under the car and talk powers gains and handling upgrades!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With our chassis and drivetrain out of the way, it’s time to get moving on the inside of the SR-71 Rapid Tool Express. But how do you organize a bunch of tools in and empty truck? Well, the guys from Summit Bodyworks do it every day on full size Cornwell tool trucks, so it’s only natural that they lend a hand in helping layout the inside our ’59 Panel to make it cool and serviceable. After that, Stacey addresses the issue of wooden floors and beds, and shows you an aluminum floor option that you’d swear came from the forest. Finally, the crew hits the road and gets a chance to talk with top fuel drag racer Leah Pritchett about her drive to become one of the best top fuelers in the nation. From design to drag racing, we’ve got it covered, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express is really taking off! We get our custom chassis from the Roadster Shop—those guys know a thing or two about quality builds. Engine Master Jon Kaase delivers a one-of-a-kind engine to power our SR-71. This build is coming together fast! With the body back on, Stacey takes you through some of the other mods that are going to tie this build in with the SR-71 Blackbird. Get ready, ya’ll, we’ve got loads of good stuff on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Season 13 is off and rumbling with Stacey showing off the new exhaust system for the SR-71 Rapid Tool Express project. From the headers to the tailpipes, this exhaust is going to scream! After that, it’s chassis details as Stacey lays out a plan for pedals, brakes and a fuel tank. Of course You can’t have an SR-71 inspired build without some killer wheels and wait ‘til you see what Stacey and our good friends at Neely Precision come up with. It’s all good, and it’s all here, this week on GearZ

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The biggest Toy in the shop is back... HEAVY METAL! Yes... Our old junk yard International Tow Truck rolls back into the garage as the freshly painted cab returns from the Hot Rot Institute. And it’s not just any paint, It’s Razzleberry from Axalta that’s so candy, you’ll want to take a bite! But there’s no time for that because Stacey jumps right in to putting a face and interior back in this old junkyard dog. The result will make you really glad that he rescued this one from the crusher! It’s recycling at it’s best... it’s GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re moving full steam ahead with the Interior of the Heavy Metal cab coming together and now’s the time to get the dash set up. We’ve got new gauges, old gauges and a bunch of empty holes where switches and knobs lived in this truck’s former life. Stacey lays out the dos and donts of getting your dash updated and a layout that makes sense before it gets installed. GearZ hits the road with a special delivery for the Hot Rod Institute for all they’ve done for us and the restoration industry. Feeling a little down about your project? Well, Stacey has a tool tech that’s sure to lift you up! All this and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express returns as Stacey digs into his old ’59 ford panel truck and shows how to convert it into a one-off tool delivery truck to show off a variety of Cornwell tools. From special shelves, lighting and floor, there are even a few surprises that are tucked away inside this rolling tool cart! Moving to the cab of the vehicle, Stacey addresses some of the issues people have when setting up seats and steering, and shows some simple tricks that make a huge difference in getting your seats and steering dialed in. Then it’s on the rear to lay out the gas tank, and then finally the SR-71 gets a new beak.... from a ’59 T-bird! ...What?!?.... how is that possible? Well, ya gotta watch GEARZ to find out!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Jeep may be the single most modified vehicle out there. From winches to lights, doors and fenders, if you’ve got a Jeep, it probably has some accessories on it. But despite all that, one of the best things about a Jeep is the removable top. It also sparks one of the biggest debates... What is best: a soft top or a hard top? Stacey takes on the challenge by comparing a factory hard top with the new Bestop Trektop. The test will include everything from ease of install to styling, overall sound decibels and of course, how watertight it is. Hopefully you won’t get wet on this ride! Then it’s back to the shop where Stacey shows you that rotisseries aren’t just for chickens, and how an automotive rotisserie can make life in the shop a lot easier. Finally, it’s on to the right and wrong way to use weatherstrip adhesive to hold your rubbers on. Sound risqué? It’s not... it’s just GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s all about square body GM trucks, because The Stunt Double is back in the shop. First, we take a look back at the this awesome ‘86 Chevy 4x4 Silverado long bed build that pays tribute to the legendary Fall Guy TV truck. From its beginnings as a well-worn farm truck, you’ll see it get an upgraded suspension, interior, drivetrain, as we make it better than I was before... better... stronger... faster... wait, that was a DIFFERENT Lee Majors TV show! After that, we walk you through the paint job and show how it is similar to the Fall Guy truck, only different.... because It’s the Stunt Double!!! No hocus pocus... no movie magic... just a tough truck being built to handle the toughest stunts... only on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express is back on the block and going back together for the last time. Stacey finishes up the frame into a rolling masterpiece with the suspension and drivetrain assembled for the last time. Then the body goes back on, and the interior starts to go together. We’re talking fitting the carpet, steering column and the new dash bezel and stuffing that bezel with custom SR-71 gauges. After that, Stacey shows some tricks on how to choose the right transmission and why rechargeable power tools are giving the tried and true air tools a run for their money! It's all here and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With the e85 market and flex fuel vehicles growing every day, Stacey dives into the myths and truths that surround ethanol and whether or not it’s a good choice for your vehicle. With a little help from Advanced Fuel Dynamics, Stacey installs a new fuel delivery system on a 2017 Mustang to show just how easy it is to up your performance and keep your engine safe at the same time. After that, Stacey and the crew head out west to tell the story of Bestop and how they’ve been making removable Jeep tops for decades. From rock-crawlers to the mall crawlers, Bestops unique past allows us to see what the future of the Jeep world will be. Finally, if you’re trying to decide between a stick or automatic transmission… hang out for a while as Stacey talks about converting your boring automatic to a lively manual transmission. We’ve got all this and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E01 - Costa Rica
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore Zunya, an eco-village, and its enchanting blue zone concept. We delve into communal living, uncovering its allure. At La Senda, we experience soul cleansing Temazcal and a sublime cacao ceremony. We engage in a farm-to-table activity, savouring locally sourced ingredients. Cala Luna offers a rejuvenating body treatment amidst serene surroundings. We encounter the Maleku Tribes, witnessing their dance ceremony and visiting their cacao farm. The journey concludes with a breath taking hike and a majestic volcano view, reminding us of nature's beauty. This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.desc: Scott and Justin ultimately find themselves in the midst of some of the most wild roads and dangerous animals on the planet. Sleeping in a tree-blind while lions walk directly under them or taking a walking safari is no match to the real situation with the people they meet. The guys experience a way of life that is so drastically different than theirs, impoverished and battling the HIV/AIDS epidemic, the guys witness the joy and sorrow at a small church ceremony and gain a fresh outlook from their new Zambian friends.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.sub-title: The World Is Yours - Salzburg, Bangkok & Charleston
programme.desc: We will go to the birthplace of Mozart, one of the most famous and influential classical music composers music in the world ... in Salzburg, Austria. From one iconic city to another, we will arrive at Bangkok, Thailand. We will climb the Skytrain, and travel to one of the most legendary snake farms on the planet ... calm! the extraction of the poison and manipulation of the snakes, we will leave them to the experts ... we will only observe. Then our trip takes us to the South of the United States of America, to receive much of the southern hospitality that characterizes that part of the country. But do not let the quiet environment fool you; There is a lot to do in, Charleston, South Carolina!

programme.title: A Long Weekend in... With Rory O'Connell
programme.desc: Rory O’Connell’s brand new series combines travel and cookery with the popular chef enjoying the culture as well as the cuisine of eight European cities – Palma de Mallorca, Vienna, Lisbon, Madrid, Bath, Nantes, Copenhagen and Edinburgh. Rory visits a different city in each episode, and while the primary focus is on food, Rory is a knowledgeable guide to so much more, with art and design being particular interests of his. Food becomes much more interesting when seen in context – the culture it is part of the landscape it’s produced in, the history that has influenced it. At the end of each episode, Rory makes a delicious dish with the local produce which he sources on his travels.

Durante su reunión con Braulio

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 118: El Verdadero Matrimonio de Luis Fernando
programme.desc: Ramón esta fuera de si, le reclama a su esposa por que dejo que su hija llegara a ese estado de gravedad, ella todavía como que no entiende el peligro que corre su hija, y de lo único que se preocupa es de su marido y de la presencia de Matilde, quien ofrece su ayuda y les siguiere consultar a un psicólogo amigo suyo. Entre tanto lo que están que se comen con la mirada son Gonzalo y Yenilu, esa muchacha lo escucha, se ríe de sus chistes, lo hace sentir otro hombre, nuevo, interesante, le sube el ego, Egleé y su hijo miran la escena y se preguntan que pasaría de enterarse Matilde, se les acerca Santiago y Luis Fernando le dice que se ponga las pilas, por que su novia, o sea Yenilu, le esta coqueteando a su tío, el al principio no entiende, pero luego la justifica, total no hay nada de malo en que conversen. Dileidi esta mas contenta que muchacho con zapatos nuevos, jura que su novio le va pedir matrimonio, el habla con su mamá le dice que se va a casar, Egleé siente que se muere, cuando se entera que Rómulo lo sabía se lo reclama enfurecida, como es posible que su hijo tiene cosas mas importantes y el no se las dice a ella, en cambio la persigue por todas partes, el al final le dice que la miss esta embarazada y que por lo tanto serán abuelos, Egleé rompe en llanto, tanto que soñó cuando ese momento llegara y ahora esta separa de Rómulo el hombre con quien en algún momento de su vida había planeado hasta ser abuelos. Están corriendo la miss y Cristina, ella le pregunta que paso con los ejercicios fuertes que ella hacía, la miss que no quiere que nadie sepa lo de su embarazo le dice que ahora solo caminaran, Gerson las ve y le dice a Cristina que serán familia, María Gracia le aclara que Luis Fernando se va a casar es con ella y no con Dileidi. Ya es la hora del almuerzo, Dileidi esta impaciente por salir no tanto a comer sino a que su novio termine de pedirle matrimonio, pero Marco Aurelio les estropea el plan, pues convoca a todo el personal a una reunión, bueno ni modo ahora tendrán que esperar par la cena, Luis Fernando hubiera preferido hablar el día siguiente, pero Dileidi no puede mas. Ya en la reunión cada quien esta mas pendientes de sus propios pensamientos que de otra cosa. Tatiana es la que esta en un mar de llanto, su mamá trata infructuosamente de consolarla, llega Aristigueta en ese momento y también hace lo propio, a la nena le molesta que después de tanto tiempo desaparecido ahora se aparezca de buenas a primeras a querer retomar el puesto de padre. Theo cree que Angel esta mas pelado que no se sabe, ahora y que hay una mujer que le dió un hijo, eso no puede ser, llega Gladis en ese momento y le dice que esa mujer es ella, que ya no aguanta mas, que se consigue a Aristigueta en todos lados, hasta lo vio esa misma tarde cargando el Yuger, es ese el momento que esperaba Theo, ahora si cree que Angel no esta tan equivocado como el creía, todos se sorprenden con la noticia que les da Gladis, pero en ese momento llega Gerson y los termina de sorprender por la noticia que trae del matrimonio, que no es precisamente el de su hermana con el sifrino ese. Ya están en el restauran los novios, Dileidi pide champaña, pues la ocasión lo amerita, Luis Fernando se confunde un poco, pero igual acepta, luego ella impaciente le pide que le diga o que le pida pues lo que le iba a pedir, entonces arranca Luis Fernando y le dice que el se casa es el pero no con ella sino con la miss, la pobre muchacha no sabe que hacer, se imagina armando un escándalo, pero en realidad, se hace la amplia, traga grueso, y finge que no pasa nada, mas loco queda el con la actitud de ella, hasta quiere comer. Entre tanto en la casa de Egleé se descorcha una botella de champaña para brindar por los novios, pero solo esta la novia, todos le dicen que se vaya acostumbrando pues Luis Fernando es así. El pobre Aureliano no aguanta tanto despecho, escucha la música de su papá, cuando Gabriel le pregunta que le pasa el le cuenta que su casi bonita se va a casar con el firifiri ese, Gabriel le dice que si abra matrimonio y por todo lo alto pero no con Dileidi sino con la novia de Luis Fernando, o sea con la miss, a Aureliano le vuelve el alma al cuerpo, besa a su papá le da las gracias por tan buena noticia y sale lleno de alegría. De nuevo en el restauran Luis Fernando sigue consternado, le dice a Dileidi que por que no reclama, por que no grita, ella le dice que no esta acostumbrada a dar ese tipo de espectáculos, le dice que ya que sabe que el se va a casar es con la miss, entonces que le diga ahora que es lo que el le iba a pedir a ella.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 63: La fortuna de Ines revelada
programme.desc: En un bar se encuentran Asdrúbal y Luis Guillermo. Asdrúbal se le pasaron los tragos y se pone a hablar con Luis Guillermo sobre el asunto del robo de la disquera por Armando Malavé a los Nuñez.. Luis Guillermo trata de Asdrúbal le cuente más sobre ese asunto, pero como él está borracho, no se le entiende nada. Le dan café pero él se queda dormido en la barra del bar. Inés le cuenta a Asunta lo relacionado a los documentos encontrados. Marta ataja a Inés y le dice a Asunta que Inés es la dueña de todo ya que su padre antes de morir le dejó toda su fortuna a Carlos Nuñez. Cuando muere Carlos Nuñez le deja la fortuna a Reinaldo Nuñez. Asunta indignada dice que entonces todo lo que dilapidaron los Nuñez era de Inés.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Simón quiere recuperar a Iris porque él la sigue amando, pero ella todavía se desiste a él. Vicenta sigue coqueteando con Cristian. Abril e Inmaculada siguen amenazadas por la presencia de Salomón, quien dice que solo ha regresado para destruirles la vida. Es por eso que le cuenta a Alejandro que no solo ha estado casado con Abril, sino que también tuvieron una hija. Luego de esto, Abril le tuvo que contar la verdad, y decirle que la nena estaba muerta. Sin embargo no le cuenta el motivo del fallecimiento, diciéndole que aún no está preparada para hablar de algo así. Josué y Ruth se juntan a hablar y Josué le pide perdón. Ella lo perdona, pero sin embargo él le dice que lo hacía para olvidarla, no porque tenga intenciones de que vuelvan a tener una relación.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 75: El beso, la reconciliacion y el reclamo
programme.desc: Salvador confundido se separa del beso, Umma confiesa que se moría de ganas por hacerlo, Socorro sale corriendo, está muerta de la ira, él la sigue hasta el apartamento. La pelea entre las boxeadoras comienza, muchas veces es golpeada La Loba, hasta que finalmente se cae por un knockout, Manuel está muy mal al verla tan golpeada. Julio Cesar se despide de Josefina diciéndole que se va a ir a vivir con Mercedes. Socorro se reconcilia con Salvador, deciden volver a ser pareja. Al siguiente día, Josefina busca a Salvador y le reclama por el beso que se dio con Umma, él también furioso la frena diciéndole que eso es un problema entre Coco y él, y que ya se reconciliaron, ella queda en shock, en el fondo le alegraba que hubieran terminado.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 71: Secuestro de Gabriela, busqueda y perdon
programme.desc: Gabriel conversa con Pantoja al informar a este de la situación de secuestro de Gabriela. Isabella se decide a darle frente a la amenaza que consiste la presencia de Isadora en la casa de Alfonso, tras darse a la tarea de proteger a Gabriela y mantener oculto su paradero. Ricardo se mantiene alerta ante la búsqueda de Gabriela al contar con la ayuda de gavilán e insistir en encontrar alguna pista sobre su novia. En el bar las Pomarrosas, Berta se reconcilia con su hija Abril al otorgarle su perdón. Marisela conversa con Mirna logrando informarla de la desaparición de Gabriela, Luly interviene en la conversación entre Marisela y Mirna para ofrecer su ayuda tras informarla de su amistad con los muchachos.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 72: Descubrimiento, celos y un nuevo engano.
programme.desc: Gabriel al ser testigo de la relación entre Isadora y Alfonso delata ante los padres de su esposa lo acontecido tras haberlos visto besándose. Isadora al saberse descubierta por Gabriel en su infidelidad se obliga a pensar en una nueva artimaña para retener a Gabriel a su lado al sentir el temor de saberlo perdido definitivamente por causa de su descuido. Arelys intenta apaciguar la difícil situación entre Christian y Pantoja al suplicarle a su hijo serenidad después de haber sido nuevamente victima de los maltratos de Pantoja quien dejándose llevar por sus celos cae nuevamente en la tentación de ser un maltratador.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 73: El Amor Se Consuma En El Agua
programme.desc: Ricardo le jura a su mama, mientras que Marisela le indica que no puede ser, porque ellos son hermanos. Ricardo lanza el teléfono al agua, y se reúne con Gabriela que lo esta esperando en el agua, se besan con pasión, y él le dice que nunca había sentido tanto amor por nadie, como lo estaba sintiendo por ella, Gabriela le dice que aún conociendo toda la verdad, aún la seguía amando, Ricardo le dice que si, que el tampoco es el que ella creía, se acarician y consumen su amor. Mientras que Jesús le pregunta a Marisela que donde esta ese muchacho para irlo a buscar para caerle a palos, y Marisela le dice que no sabe, que Ricardo solo le dijo que estaban en el lugar mas lindo que el había visto en su vida

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 74: El Plan de Alfonso y Marisela
programme.desc: Alfonso conversa con Jesús decidiendo confesarle a este la verdad sobre su mortal enfermedad al tener la aspiración de comprar sus últimos días de vida para así poder llevar a cabo su plan de conquistar a Marisela y convertirse en su esposo. Abril recuerda a Reynaldo mientras conversa con Pantoja acerca de su mala fortuna con los hombres, tras mostrarse ilusionada con su amigo el policía al ver acercarse la posibilidad de llegar a enamorarse. Jennifer sintiéndose percatada de la felicidad de su padre informa a este sobre su aceptación de la nueva esposa por venir. Chela intenta aconsejar a Marisela al tratar de convencerla para que le de una nueva oportunidad a Gabriel tras descubrir el contenido de sus románticas cartas de amor

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 75: Crisis, Muerte y la Lucha por Vivir
programme.desc: En la clínica al salir ilesa de su accidentada incursión dentro de su casa en llamas; Marisela le pide a Chela la verdad sobre el estado de Jesús, Gabriel cumple con la penosa tarea de informar a Marisela de lo acontecido por Jesús al advertirla de su muerte, Marisela se ve víctima de una crisis nerviosa al saberse enterada de la supuesta muerte de su esposo Jesús, entre tanto en la sala de cirugía Anselmi y Diego hacen todo lo posible por salvar la vida de Alfonso. Durante su reunión con Braulio

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 59: Ines Duena de la Fortuna Nunez
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo se queda aterrado cuando descubre que Inés es la dueña total de toda la fortuna de los Nuñez y trata de que todos lo sepan, pero Inés se opone a que lo haga y lo hace callar. Mientras que Robert se molesta cuando ve llegar a Reina y la hace sacar del local por Mujiquita y se niega a oírla cuando ella le dice que tiene algo importante que contarle. Flavia trata de hacer que Diego Andrés recapacite, pero él le asegura que nunca se sacará a Marisela de adentro. Y Vicky se arrepiente de haber ido al local donde trabaja Aldo pero Gabriela insiste en que se queden para que Diana no se lo quite. Asdrúbal trata de consolar a Jean Paul que está tomando y muy triste porque Yelixa no quiere nada con él.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 60: Armando Quiere Venganza y Libertad
programme.desc: Flavia le reclama a Mauricio Castañeda que le diga el nombre de la mujer que se escapó con su esposo Armando Malavé. Mauricio le dice que no puede porque en realidad esa mujer es su esposa. En un terreno abandonado 2 hombres encuentran a Armando y Solbella, los cuales están amarrados y tirados en el suelo. Estos hombres los desatan y los dejan en libertad. Solbella le dice a Armando que aprovechen y se fuguen. Armando le dice que él siendo un hombre tan importante, no puede hacer eso. Que quiere regresar y vengarse. Diego Andrés trata de convencer a Cheíto para que le de la dirección de Marisela. Cheíto le dice que no y que olvide a Marisela.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 61: Robert y la sucursal de Aruba
programme.desc: Robert quiere adelantar su boda con Inés para ir a atender la sucursal que tienen en Aruba, Armando se opone a la idea de Robert y le dice que como el ya regreso su cargo como presidente se le acabo. A Inés tampoco le gusto la idea. Daniela aprovecho el momento para solicitar ese puesto para su novio Luis Guillermo .Armando se burla de la sugerencia que le hace Daniela. Por otra parte Diego Andrés se encuentra a Maricela trabajando en una bomba de gasolina Maricela trata de que el no se de cuenta de que ella esta hay pero el la ve y sale corriendo detrás de ella pero no la logra alcanzar.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 62: Ines Confiesa Su Amor a Luis Guillermo
programme.desc: Diego Andrés obliga a Inés a aceptar que ama a Luis Guillermo quien oye todo, pero son interrumpidos por la llegada de Gabriela que viene a averiguar sobre Jean Paul y se niega a aceptar que éste haya sido reclutado y jura que lo sacará de allí pero el grupo formado por Inés, Luis Guillermo y Diego Andrés se niegan a oírla pues le dicen que es mejor que éste se convierta de una vez en un hombre y en el ejército podrá lograrlo. Marisela trata de consolar al padre Darío por la muerte de su padre y el padre le pide que le cuente que fue lo que pasó realmente.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 63: La fortuna de Ines revelada
programme.desc: En un bar se encuentran Asdrúbal y Luis Guillermo. Asdrúbal se le pasaron los tragos y se pone a hablar con Luis Guillermo sobre el asunto del robo de la disquera por Armando Malavé a los Nuñez.. Luis Guillermo trata de Asdrúbal le cuente más sobre ese asunto, pero como él está borracho, no se le entiende nada. Le dan café pero él se queda dormido en la barra del bar. Inés le cuenta a Asunta lo relacionado a los documentos encontrados. Marta ataja a Inés y le dice a Asunta que Inés es la dueña de todo ya que su padre antes de morir le dejó toda su fortuna a Carlos Nuñez. Cuando muere Carlos Nuñez le deja la fortuna a Reinaldo Nuñez. Asunta indignada dice que entonces todo lo que dilapidaron los Nuñez era de Inés.

programme.title: Amor Secreto

programme.title: Amor Secreto

programme.title: Amor Secreto

programme.title: Amor Secreto

programme.title: Amor Secreto

programme.desc: Stroll down Grant Street with Laura into the heart of America's largest Chinatown. Bike, drive, or walk across the Golden Gate Bridge, the city's most recognizable landmark. Finally, Fisherman's Wharf offers day trips all wrapped into one fun location.

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: First, head over to Castle Rock. Then, venture down to the Royal Mile that provides fascinating insights into the region's history, and is a charming street of pubs, restaurants, and shops. Also, take a moment to revel in the glory of St Giles' Cathedral.

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: Whether by foot, bike, or boat, Laura hits all the hotspots in Amsterdam, such as the Rijksmuseum and the Hotel De L'Europe. She even takes a day-trip outside the city to explore neighboring Volendam and picturesque Volendam Harbor and drops into the Rembrandt Hoeve Cheesefarm and Clog Factory.

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: Auckland is New Zealand's largest city. Laura takes an hour's drive south of Auckland to a working sheep farm in the New Zealand countryside. A few miles down the road, Laura spies a familiar sight - Hobbiton, the set from the Lord of the Rings films where Bilbo lived before and after his journey.

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: Accompany travel savvy hostess Laura McKenzie as she interviews His Serene Highness Prince Albert II of Monaco. Stroll through the gardens, and witness the glamorous and dazzling cities of Monaco and Monte Carlo.

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: Laura McKenzie will take you to the oldest part of the city, on the Buda side, to the old Castle District. Behold a bronze statue of King St. Stephen, one of the most beautiful monuments in Hungary. Enjoy the Budapest Puppet Theatre, as well as the Opera House.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.sub-title: Orange County, California: Irvine and Dana Point
programme.desc: Colleen's family ride electric bikes at Pedego and explore Irvine's international dining destination, Diamond Jamboree. They end in Dana Point with a visit to the Ocean Institute that includes a whale and dolphin watching excursion.

programme.title: Travels with Darley
programme.desc: Darley meets James Beard award-winning chefs in Birmingham and discovers the favorite hot spots for the Crimson Tide on game days. In Marion, Civil Rights history, biscuit making, and organic farming converge.

programme.title: Travels with Darley
programme.desc: The historic Route 66 is alive with American history. Join Darley on a road trip from Chicago to St. Louis where the infamous road began to discover the places and stories peppered along the route. Step back in time along The Mother Road.

programme.title: Tastes Like Home
programme.desc: Catherine meets with Lilian Parkes in Belfast's verdant Botanic Gardens before travelling to Johannesburg to meet her best friend Laura where the two will experience myriad facets of South African life, culture, and cuisine.

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Why is there a giant church complex, the DomQuartier, in this tiny Alpine town, and why is there an equally giant medieval fortress high above it? Who lived in Mirabell Palace, and Hellbrun Palace? Why is Getreidegassse so charming? And how do you solve a problem like Maria?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Why does Paris look like it does? Why were the Eiffel Tower and the Pont Alexandre III built? Why is the Opera Garnier so ornate? Why is there an eastern-style basilica atop the highest point in Paris? Why was a cabaret built inside a red mill (the Moulin Rouge)?

programme.title: What's Eating Harlem
programme.desc: Meet the mastermind behind Lady Lexis Sweets and the delicious treats found there, visit Ginny's Supper Club for an intimate conversation with Author Monica Rich Kosann and Journalist Tamron Hall, and experience the energy of Double Dutch.

programme.title: What's Eating Harlem
programme.desc: Find out how to make the perfect Cuban sandwich at Pilar Cuban Eatery in Brooklyn, meet the fabulous people behind the film Chapter & Verse at the Cove Lounge in Harlem, and celebrate Charles Rangel, a man with deep roots in Harlem.

programme.title: Andiamo! Uptown
programme.desc: Donna explores Dubai, one of the gems of the Middle East. While there, she discovers Emirati culture and cuisine, experiences an upscale desert safari, goes scuba diving, and more. There is so much to experience in Dubai.

programme.title: Food Relay
programme.desc: Paige discovers how one river split Serbia's geography, history, and food. Belgrade is infused with Turkish influence, whereas Novi Sad's Austrian roots run deep. Will Paige successfully hunt the poultry required for a Thanksgiving meal?

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Utrera, Spain contains a strong flamenco heritage, as is evident at the lively Potaje Gitano Festival. Mickela then meets a six-year-old flamenco dancer named Carmen, sits with singer Tomas De Perrate, and becomes an honorary Bell Ringer.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Dance can empower EVERYONE. A visit with The Pacemakers, STooPS Bed-Stuy, Broadway Dance Center, Table of Silence Project 9/11, and the Thunderbird American Powwow, confirms that dance can both enlighten one's spirit, and it can heal.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Mickela attends Le Fete de Bayonne to celebrate French Basque Country tradition. This includes dancing the Fandango, handling giant puppets, tasting the region's traditional cuisine, and experiencing the renowned Pastorale.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Chios is a wealthy, relatively undiscovered, island in the Aegean Sea known for silk, citrus, and a wealth of food lore, including mastiha, an ancient superfood. Diane learns to make pasta from a local cook inspiring her to cook some more.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.sub-title: Naxos: Meat and Potatoes Like You've Never Had 'em
programme.desc: Naxos is famed for the quality of its meats, its seductive array of cheeses, and its potatoes. From the Mediterranean shore Diane and Alexis travel to a remote mountain hideaway where a pair of local cooks await with a classic Naxos feast.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: In Messinia, Diane visits with a good friend who helps her discover the secrets of this rich, giving land that is blessed with a perfect climate. The region is home to the world's first system of culinary provenance, and delicious recipes.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.sub-title: Evia: An Island Hiding in Plain Sight
programme.desc: Evia is a culinary utopia, home to great seafood, a long-standing shepherding tradition, ancient spas, and snow-capped mountains. Here, Diane walks with a local mushroom expert, and is inspired to cook with some unique earthly delights.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Corfu's multifaceted cuisine is influenced by a blend of cultures, including Greek Italian, English, French, and Russian. In her kitchen, Diane cooks up a Corfiot storm of mixed braised greens with feta, bourtheto stew, and pastitsio.

programme.title: Me, Myself, and the World
programme.desc: Pamela flies to Hanoi to continue her stay in Vietnam. OneTrip Adventures is extremely helpful in creating an itinerary with her that will encapsulate the essence of the Hanoi experience, including a visit to a custom ao dai dress shop.

programme.title: Me, Myself, and the World
programme.sub-title: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam - Mekong Delta
programme.desc: Pamela visits the exciting city of Ho Chi Minh (Saigon), Vietnam, inspiring others to join her Solo Travel Revolution. She explores the Mekong Delta, visits a rice paper factory, meets locals, and tries the delicacies of the region.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.sub-title: The Lumbee Dance of the Spring Moon
programme.desc: Mickela joins a Pow Wow with the Lumbee Tribe of North Carolina and listens as the tribe reveals the obstacles a non-Federally recognized tribe faces in the United States.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Mickela celebrates the annual St. Nicholas feast with the Greek-American community in Queens, while also finding time to shine a light on the local heroes who keep Greek culture alive in New York.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Harlem is one of America's truly unique neighborhoods, one alive with culture, music, delicious cuisine, and of course, dance. This thriving neighborhood has continued its ascent since the first Harlem Renaissance.

programme.title: Dream of Italy
programme.desc: Kathy reveals the vibrant, charming side of Bologna, a city famous for its sumptuous cuisine. It is also home to the oldest university in the western world, and it is the center of Italy's "motor valley," including Lamborghini.

programme.title: Dream of Italy
programme.desc: In Perugia, we meet two women carrying on their family traditions of handmade stained glass and textiles, and we indulge in Baci candy. In Montefalco, Kathy tours the Tenuta Castelbuono winery, and enjoys a cooking lesson.

programme.title: Dream of Italy
programme.desc: Abruzzo is filled with mountains, national parks, and beautiful beaches. Host Kathy McCabe takes viewers from coast to countryside as she catches her lunch, listens to traditional music, tastes confetti candies, and seeks donkey therapy.

programme.desc: Saratoga, New York was the location of a major turning point in the American Revolution. Sumptuous food and beer prepare us for visits to Schuyler House, Saratoga Monument, and Saratoga National Historical Park to feel history's energy.

programme.title: Travels with Darley

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Ana María González, coach fitness apasionada por ayudar a las personas a encontrar constancia y propósito en el movimiento. Desde consejos prácticos para tonificar el cuerpo, mejorar la postura o fortalecer el core, hasta herramientas para establecer objetivos realistas y sostenibles, nos comparte cómo pequeños hábitos pueden transformar nuestra salud física y mental. Ana nos adentra en el mundo del indoor cycling, una disciplina de alta intensidad que ha ganado popularidad por su impacto positivo en la salud y su capacidad de conectar con la música y la motivación colectiva. Además, hablamos sobre nuevas tendencias como el Barré y el Hyrox, la importancia de romper estereotipos de género en el fitness y cómo el ejercicio puede convertirse en una experiencia 360 que va más allá del cuerpo, impulsando comunidad, autoconocimiento y bienestar.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: En este episodio nuestra invitada es Yadira Pérez, actriz nominada al Ariel y a Las Diosas de Plata por su participación en “SUJO”, película que fue seleccionada para representar a México en los Premios Oscar y Goya 2025. Yadira comparte cómo el teatro se convirtió en su gran escuela de vida, su manera de construir personajes inspirados en mujeres reales y la pasión que siente cada vez que pisa un escenario o un set de cine. Además, reflexiona sobre la conexión entre actores y directores, los retos de reconocerse a sí misma como artista y el papel del cuerpo como vehículo de emociones. Un episodio que celebra el amor al arte dramático, la fuerza de las historias y el camino de una actriz que sigue conquistando con su entrega y sensibilidad.

programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Sergio Gutiérrez, actor, guionista y director independiente, sobre sus inicios en la actuación, su pasión por los escenarios y el proceso de construir personajes completos. Con una trayectoria que incluye participaciones en series de televisión, streaming y teatro, Sergio comparte anécdotas de sets masivos, entrenamientos con dobles de riesgo y su paso por producciones como míticas. Reflexionamos sobre la importancia de no juzgar a sus propios personajes, la presencia total en escena, y el valor del capital humano en tiempos de inteligencia artificial. Una charla auténtica y dinámica que revela lo que significa vivir la actuación desde todas sus trincheras.

programme.desc: Un hombre infame conocido como "Pistolas de Oro" tiene la costumbre de disparar a la gente en defensa propia. En uno de esos casos está herido y visita a un sacerdote que atiende sus heridas y le aconseja que cambie su vida. Él busca un trabajo honesto, pero su reputación no le permite, por lo que es difícil obtener un trabajo. Él encuentra trabajo en una feria donde conoce a Laura, otra trabajadora, y crecen cerca, pero ella no sabe nada de su pasado.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Han pasado veinte años. Una familia de un renombrado artista llega a la ciudad costera para pasar el verano. Se trata de Dmitri, Ksenia y su hija Rita. Pronto, Ksenia recibe una invitación para una reunión de excompañeros de escuela y decide asistir. En el fondo, no puede negar su deseo de volver a ver a Piotr. Mientras tanto, su hija Rita, de 19 años, se ve envuelta en una situación peligrosa, de la que es rescatada por Piotr. Ahora él es un hombre respetado en la ciudad: periodista, empresario y editor de un importante periódico local. En sus manos tiene una historia explosiva sobre corrupción con antiguas casas de campo estatales del partido, propiedades de gran valor. Entre Rita y Piotr comienza a surgir una atracción.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de su hija, pero él se mantiene firme: una vez dejó ir a su gran amor y no piensa cometer el mismo error de nuevo. Está decidido a luchar por Rita. Ksenia escucha lo mismo de su hija: ella no piensa renunciar a Piotr por la opinión de sus padres. Mientras tanto, el escándalo de las casas estatales sigue creciendo. Un colega de Piotr, Edik, descubre que su teléfono está siendo intervenido. La persona detrás de esto pertenece a la élite política. Pronto, dos desconocidos irrumpen en la oficina del periódico exigiendo que entreguen el expediente comprometedor, o la familia de Piotr estará en peligro.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Piotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres por seguridad. Ksenia acepta una tregua temporal con él. Piotr entrega su artículo para la próxima edición del periódico, pero por órdenes "desde arriba", toda la tirada es retirada bajo la acusación de difamación. Mientras tanto, Dmitri no renuncia a su plan de separar a Piotr y Rita. Se reúne con el exnovio de su hija, Aleksandr, instructor del centro náutico, y le da su visto bueno para retomar la relación con Rita… siempre y cuando logre deshacerse de Piotr.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Pyotr y Ksenia terminan sus estudios y tienen una vida adulta e independiente por delante. Los jóvenes se aman desde hace tiempo y con devoción y ya piensan en formar una familia. Un día, el padre de Ksenia, que trabaja como jefe de una empresa de construcción, se mete en problemas. Es sospechoso de blanqueo de dinero a gran escala y en un futuro próximo no sólo se arriesga a perder todo su patrimonio, sino también a ir a la cárcel durante mucho tiempo. De repente, un viejo conocido de la madre de Ksenia, Grigory Dmitrievich, que ocupa un alto cargo en la administración local de la ciudad, se ofrece a resolver los problemas de su padre. Sin embargo, pone una única condición a cambio: Ksenia debe casarse con su hijo Dima, un futuro pintor que estudia pintura en un colegio.

programme.title: Amada
programme.desc: Semyon Tarasov era una gerente exitoso, que hace un año dejo su trabajo el hipermercado “La Almohada favorita”. Después de culminar sus estudios y prácticas en el extranjero regresó a trabajar a la misma empresa, pero ya como director de la sucursal. Antes le llamaban simplemente Syoma, ahora debían llamarle por su nombre y patronímico, es decir, Semyon Olegovich. ¡Pero qué difícil es convencer a la gente de que ahora las reglas del juego han cambiado y que en lugar de un trato amistoso debería haber respeto! ¿Cómo inculcar asombro y respeto en los empleados? Aquí todos lo conocen como Syoma, el que animaba enérgicamente al equipo de fútbol en el bar con sus amigos, iba a hacer rafting en el río con otros, y con una mujer... con Lena ... Lena! Fueron pareja durante casi un año y vivían juntos, hasta que a Syoma le ofrecieron una pasantía. Él y Lena se amaban, y luego... ¿Qué pasó entonces? Entonces Syoma se convenció a sí mismo de que no se amaban en lo absoluto, sino que se tenían afecto, intimidad y una vida juvenil juntos. Se convenció de esto a sí mismo para no sentirse un vil traidor, porque sabía que había dejado a Lena por su carrera. Y Syoma realmente no falló en al lograr sus sueños. ¿y que paso con Lena? a Syoma se le olvidó lo hermosa que es. ¡Pero qué es esto! ¿Lena... está embarazada? Syoma cuenta frenéticamente los meses y los días y comprende que no es posible que él sea el padre de este niño. Si en dado caso Lena estuviera embarazada y estuviera a punto de dar a luz, tendría solo nueve meses de embarazo, pero Syoma no ha estado en Moscú desde hace 12 meses!

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Huckberry Homes
programme.sub-title: "Experience a Recording Studio On the Edge of Iceland's Arctic Circle | Ep. 5"
programme.desc: "On this special edition of Huckberry Homes, we explore Floki Studios. Floki Studios is a renowned recording studio nestled in the rugged seaside of Iceland, offering artists an unparalleled environment for creativity and collaboration. Situated on the fringes of the Arctic Circle, this sanctuary provides a haven far removed from the bustling distractions of urban life. Surrounded by the untouched beauty of Iceland's pristine nature, Floki Studios is more than just a recording space; it's a haven designed to inspire and enhance the creative journey. - Behind the scenes, Floki Studios thrives thanks to a dedicated team, deeply committed to the art of music. Jay Sweet, the Music Ambassador, stands out for his passion and advocacy for artists, embodying the studio's ethos of nurturing creativity. This partnership between Jay and the Floki Studios team exemplifies a unique blend of individual dedication and collective effort, providing artists with a space that fosters creative freedom and collaboration."
